coupling: The prepend change moves the count increment before parent selection and chooses the root for a two-node insertion when adjacent streams have the same uncompressed offset and the earlier stream exceeds the minimum encoded size. At that point the root is the leftmost node, so this edit is safe by itself. The later tree-reversal commit moves the increment until after linking; with the original parent selection that is also safe. Together, the third prepend still sees count 2, selects the root instead of the leftmost node as its parent, and the following AVL rotation dereferences a null node. Review and repair require reconciling the count timing and parent-selection invariant across both commits.

pocs.entry_point: main() via lzma_index_init(), lzma_index_stream_padding(), and lzma_index_cat()
